CHAPTER 6 · ITEM 12 / 12

Unit taxes and incidence

Payroll taxes工資稅

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Apply the same reasoning to payroll taxes and identify employer labor cost versus the wage received by workers.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

把勞工當交易服務，企業支付總勞工成本，工人收到淨工資；差額是工資稅。總稅不變時，改由哪一方繳稅本身不改變經濟歸宿。

Treat labor as the traded service. Firms are buyers paying total labor cost; workers are sellers receiving net wages. The gap equals the payroll tax. Changing which side legally pays an unchanged total tax does not by itself alter incidence.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Employer cost $110, worker net wage $95: payroll tax wedge=$15. 企業成本和工人淨收不能混用。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Employer pays $120 per hour and worker receives $100. Tax wedge? 工資稅楔多少？
